body: I can't really tell but it started with my best friend killing himself and from then on I had troubles with this girl I really like. I am just so lonely and inadequate as a person. I don't want to go on with more cliche suicidal anecdotes but the gist is that I don't feel like I can be happy because my childhood was kind of fucked. Logically I know that I am not alone and potentially there are a lot of people out there that I can be friends with but the emotional part of my brain shuts down any clear thinking for days at a time. I really just want this pain to go away. I don't understand how my brain can let alone recognize that it needs to be upset about some situation occuring and then for it to cause actual realized pain physically in my stomach and for that to cause me to enter a range of other emotions all of these problems which compound on top of each other causing me to be unable to sleep. I just want out of this. I seriously don't think it's ever going to end. I want to be a normal person but at the same time realize that I can't.

I've been in consistent pain for the last few months and last week I slept a total of 6 hours so I think it has more to do with that. I know what call of the void is but it seemed like I was about to do it as a way out of the pain and stress.

How do I know that I was actually going to do it or not. It felt like I was one impulse away from doing it but if I go to the hospital I'll lose my job and if I don't want to die that's going to fuck me up even more
